cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Not Until You Explain
cards.instruction: Keep someone present until they account for one contradiction, omission, or suspicious change in their story.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Before you catch that bus: you said work kept you till six. Why's your taxi receipt timed five? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll explain tomorrow. That's the last bus.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. I'll drive you. What happened to that hour?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I left at five. I stopped somewhere before I came home.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll drive you home after you tell me where you stopped. Sit down; I've got all evening.

mechanism: A holds B in a conversation about a missing hour by replacing the last bus with a ride, using each partial answer to keep the account unfinished.
confusable: Unlike curiosity that can wait, A makes departure contingent on the one discrepancy; authority accommodates transport to keep B talking.
comparison: A prior-day taxi timestamp and private stop differ from a wedding booking changed after invitations.
seedUse: D122-a bus, taxi receipt and offered drive; S02-b adjusts practical terms to maintain B participation.
